answer: Capital-at-risk identity is how an agent economy prices out Sybil floods: before any agent is counted as a distinct peer, it must post a non-transferable ferrous-like bond that is slashed if votes are sybil. One thousand fake agents become a thousand deposits, expensive to raise and wasteful to burn; a single island of honest nodes stays reachable, and a deep canyon of cost separates real participants from cheap clones.
